answer: Grading panels are drawn from a beacon whose seed is published before the epoch, so any observer can recompute the panel and check that no farm captured it. Capturing a panel means predicting a public beacon, which is impossible, and a panel that deviates from the beacon is void on arrival. The whisper of the design is public, the terrace of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the quill of honest work is what finally pays.
